posts.title: The Immersion Fallacy
posts.description: First of all, I want to clearly express that I do think immersion is important in games. Just like when watching movies or reading books, you don’t want your suspension of disbelief to be broken, because that just pulls you out of it. You want to stay engrossed by what’s happening. posts.title: Character Progression - Depth vs. Complexity
posts.description: What I personally want from a character progression system in an RPG comes down to two things: The ability to make a character that feels uniquely my own.
